description: Source code for unit display and attack animations in the Wesnoth game, including movement, attack, and death animations, with map scrolling and fog handling.

methods.name: adjust_map_position
methods.description: Centers the map view around a rectangle, scrolling if necessary.

methods.name: move_unit_between
methods.description: Animates moving a unit between two map locations, including teleportation and map scrolling.

methods.name: unit_visible_on_path
methods.description: Checks if a unit is visible on a given path considering fog and enemy visibility.

methods.name: move_unit
methods.description: Animates moving a unit along a path, handling visibility, map scrolling, and fog.

methods.name: unit_die
methods.description: Animates a unit's death, including sound and visual effects.

methods.name: unit_attack
methods.description: Handles attack animations between units, including ranged and melee, with effects and death handling.
